newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson-CSF suitors known April 7, no GEC comment.
newsitem.headline: Thomson-CSF suitors known April 7, no GEC comment.

text.p: Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Thursday the French government would reveal on Monday April 7 the identity of the suitors whose candidacies in the bidding for Thomson-CSF had been declared eligible.

Arthuis, who was speaking at a fortnightly press briefing, declined to comment on statements by French company Lagardere on Wednesday that British group General Electric Co Plc had submitted a bid. GEC has also declined all comment.
Pressed by reporters in France's position regarding foreign bids in the privatisation of the Thomson-CSF defence electronics group, Arthuis limited himself to saying: "France is a welcoming country."
French missiles-to-publishing group Lagardere and industrial giant Alcatel Alsthom have both confirmed that they are in the running.

The government scrapped an initial attempt to privatise the entire Thomson SA group -- comprising Thomson-CSF and Thomson Multimedia last year after objections from the independent Privatisation Commission.
